title: Linear extension from unit-scalar section-germ generators
statement: For the same data and full equation as the item, the arbitrary coefficient and stalk-element comparison follows from the unit-scalar section-germ generator equation by linearity and germ generation.

source.place: Tags 0098 and 0096; Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules/Sheaf.lean, restrictStalkNatIso and its germ formulas.

proof.text: Apply the canonical c = 1 equation, multiply by the canonical output scalar e(c), and rewrite pure tensors using ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.smul_tmul and mul_one. The tensor-stalk maps and the stalk of the inverse pinned comparison are linear by map_smul. The output coordinate is semilinear by the proved private open_coordinate_smul helper, which imports the existing Scheme.restriction_stalk_smul from OpenModuleStalkRestrictionComparison using import all, then identifies the inverse inclusion stalk map using Scheme.Opens.stalkIso_inv. These rewrites give the arbitrary-scalar equation.

proof_origin.note: Scalar extension proved from the canonical unit-scalar theorem and the existing private restriction-stalk semilinearity theorem, imported with import all; duplicate helpers removed in repair X-81ed4.

mathlib_searches.query: The canonical open restriction of tensor pullback sends a pure tensor of germs to the ambient pure germ tensor under inverse inclusion stalk maps

mathlib_searches.results: restrictStalkNatIso and its hom/inv germ formulas found.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Supplies same-germ maps, but no chain-level normalized semilinear coordinate or pinned tensor comparison equation.

mathlib_searches.query: restrictStalkNatIso; tensorStalkIso; openPinnedTensorRestrictionIso; RestrictionStalkExtensionIso in Mathlib, WeilConjectures and Sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Read the definitions and pinned adjunction formulas. Existing RestrictionStalkExtensionIso proves an existential extension-of-scalars isomorphism without the required canonical component formula.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the canonical restriction map; isolate only the pinned comparison generator equation.

from.place: Open-locality of the single-complex stalk comparison: ordinary ring coordinates and the tensor germ comparison of Tag 0098.

lean.statement:
theorem openOrdinaryTensor_pure_germ_coordinates_linear_extension
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (V : S.Opens) (V' : S'.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (j : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι ≫ g')
    (sq₀ : IsPullback j (f' ∣_ V') (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V V' hV'))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (z : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme) :
    letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).Additive :=
      schemeOpenRestriction_additive X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
      Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _
    let Q₀ := ((schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let R₀ := R (f ∣_ V) j z
    let A₀ := A j z
    let B₀ := B (f' ∣_ V') z
    let C₀ := C z
    let R₁ := R f g' z.val
    let A₁ := A g' z.val
    let B₁ := B f' z.val
    let C₁ := C z.val
    letI := leftAlgebra (f ∣_ V) j z
    letI := rightAlgebra (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z
    letI := (tensorMap (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z).toAlgebra
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z.val
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z.val
    letI := (tensorMap f f' g g' sq z.val).toAlgebra
    let K₀ := stalkComplex j z Q₀
    let K := stalkComplex g' z.val P
    let T₀ := tensorComplex (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V') (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z Q₀
    let T := tensorComplex f f' g g' sq z.val P
    let F₀ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} C₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} C₁) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let L₀ := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme.toRingedSpace z
    let γ := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V'))
        (L₀ ⋙ F₀) ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι z
    let Lᵢ := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace (j z)
    let Fᵢ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A₀) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let γᵢ := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
        (Lᵢ ⋙ Fᵢ) ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι (j z)
    let hx := congrArg (fun k : (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').toScheme ⟶ X => k z) hj
    ∀ (n : ℤ) (c : C₀) (q : K₀.X n),
          F.map ((tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq z.val P).hom.f n)
              (((f' ⁻¹ᵁ V').stalkIso z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv c ⊗ₜ[A₁,
                (algebraMap (A₁ ⊗[R₁] B₁) C₁).comp
                (algebraMap A₁ (A₁ ⊗[R₁] B₁))] (show K.X n from
                  (γᵢ.hom.app (P.X n) ≫
                    ((show X.Modules from P.X n).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hx)).hom) q)) =
            (F₀.map ((tensorStalkIso (f ∣_ V) (f' ∣_ V')
                (g.resLE V V' hV') j sq₀ z Q₀).hom.f n) ≫
              F₀.map (L₀.map ((openPinnedTensorRestrictionIso g'
                (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f' ⁻¹ᵁ V') j hj).inv.app (P.X n))) ≫
              γ.hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').obj (P.X n)))
                (c ⊗ₜ[A₀,(algebraMap (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀) C₀).comp
                  (algebraMap A₀ (A₀ ⊗[R₀] B₀))] q)
